summary: Report-to-event step for the 'institution or message' fork. Pinned Matthew 16 and 18, John 21 (same Perseus witnesses) and Dei Verbum ch. V (vatican.va web snapshot), and read Matthew 16, 18, 28 and John 20, 21 in full. Derived the narrow scope premise from a historical premise (Matthew 28.18-20 and at least one of the four governing commissions go back to Jesus; Dei Verbum §19) and a link premise (a governing power and the power to teach, if Jesus gave them, make his founding of the Catholic Church a founding in the mandate with a teaching commission; Lumen gentium §§19, 22). The link premise is strictly weaker than the narrow premise but carries the institutional content in its consequents, so the result is recorded as a transcription (single application; Codex review on #581). The fork is split: the message rival may deny the link premise, or, granting it with Jesus' mandate and his founding of the Catholic Church, must deny each of the four governing commissions; it may keep Matthew 28. Findings from the text: Matthew 16.18-19 is a promise in the future tense (oikodomēsō, dōsō); Matthew 16.18 and 18.17 are the only Gospel uses of ekklēsia; only Matthew 28.18 and John 20.21 ground the commission in Jesus' own received authority or sending; only Matthew 28.20 names teaching; recipients differ (Peter; the disciples of 18.1; the eleven; the disciples without Thomas; Peter). Rejected: (i) a premise that all five reports go back to Jesus (stronger than needed; Dei Verbum's reading is kept only as the implying statement); (ii) counting teaching or baptizing as governing, which would make the rival's Matthew 28 concession institutional and beg the question; (iii) a separate premise that the commissions were given in the mandate (Matthew 28.18, John 20.21): no recorded rival separates it, so it stays inside the link premise (decomposition gate); (iv) report statements as premises: their content is fixed by the sourced definition DEF-COMMISSION-REPORT-POWERS. Not found: a pinned source stating the historical denial of the governing sayings (Harnack's pinned section does not discuss them). As a transcription with open premises it leaves the narrow premise open; reaching the root, the two new premises are listed beside it (61 → 63 open premises, bare unchanged); route costs unchanged (cheapest 31); nothing discharged. Definition audit (2026-11-06): CommissionDefinitions now parameterizes the selected governing criterion and its matching institutional bridge without changing the original fixed Power.Governing table. Narrow and teaching-inclusive calibrations are explicit propositions, named coverage is open, and a precise further extension is retained by checked EM coverage. The actual Matthew 28 commission is a weaker historical sibling of the old report-to-event bundle, not inferred from its literal textual report. With teaching-inclusive calibration and a matching institutional bridge it supplies the original Catholic mandate target in a standalone registered result. The literal fixed broader link strengthens the old narrow link as a sole-premise certificate; the reverse fails in the exact old nonempty messageRival_compatible_with_mt28 witness. A baptize-inclusive further criterion admits the old mandate target, while a no-governing further criterion with matching bridge rejects it in a nonempty context; Other therefore opposes named coverage only. The earlier rejection of counting teaching/baptizing as governing concerned silently importing that classification into the old institutional bridge, not logical exploration of an explicit alternative with its distinct stronger applicability premise. Named elimination needs actual negation of the narrow criterion, not merely Matthew 28 insufficiency. The old argument still needs an additional governing report under its narrow table and now records why; the new route uses the weak Matthew 28 witness. All source claims, event/promise and recipient boundaries, original Lean declarations and Challenges remain unchanged. No institutional history, real-world criterion coverage or independent philosophical premise is established. Definition/endpoint audit (2026-11-06): the raw OnlyMessage thesis denies institutional founding in a mandate, not the actual grant/promise of commission powers. A nonempty model retains OnlyMessage and the full historical bundle while the institutional transfer fails. Replaced its automatic alternative endpoint with the exact report-bundle negation, derived only from the raw rival, the weak governing-event component of the old institutional bridge, and an actual mandate/founded-visible-body witness. The original teaching component is not needed for this confrontation. A checked structural transfer-or-positive-countercase fork identifies the actual omitted option; Matthew28 remains compatible. Existing nine-power table, source claims, Challenges and root routes are unchanged. Report-to-event truth and institutional applicability remain open. The sibling alternative to Catholic-only mandate scope had the same hidden actual-witness guard: two conditional universals coexist when no mandate is held. Its endpoint is now exact scope negation, proved from rawOnlyMessage plus the actual mandate/body witness by importing FoundingScope.messageRival_excludes_scope. Separate empty/nonempty controls preserve that boundary. Strength self-sweep: the old attestation route does not need the link teaching component, so a same-target weak-link sibling imports attestation_gives_governing and the new nonvacuous contradiction result; the frozen legacy interface is retained honestly. By contrast the original narrow-scope conclusion still needs both a teaching grant and a teaching-commission transfer. Two explicit nonempty omission controls retain full historical reports with a weak link, or a full link with only a governing grant, and fail teaching scope. Updated exact strong-version notes without inventing logical necessity for the attestation interface. Review correction (P1, #1158): the first MessageScopeModels target certifies only absence of the joint actual-mandate/founded-visible-body antecedent, not absence of every mandate. Corrected its advertised boundary without changing its frozen Challenge/type. A stronger standalone sibling now exports forall g not HoldsMandate plus actual Catholic founding and visibility, so consumers can recover the precise empty-mandate control from the theorem type itself.
blocker: Historical Matthew 28 authenticity, actual governance calibration and the matching institutional bridge remain open. The fixed nine-power profile is not a census of all real ecclesial power; recipient, promise/fulfillment, mandate/body scope and applicability must not be inferred by relabelling. The old narrow bridge does not support a broader criterion without an explicit stronger matching link. Conditional configuration/connection progress is distinct from premise truth or Catholicism-root closure.
